title: Consensus-based optimization for linearly separable functions
summary: Consensus-based optimization (CBO) is an efficient metaheuristic for global optimisation with attractive mathematical properties, allowing global convergence results even in non-convex settings. In practice it suffers greatly from the curse of dimensionality, as do most particle-based optimisers. Different strategies have been proposed to apply CBO even for high-dimensional optimisation problems, the most prominent being the so-called anisotropic noise model.
